title: brisk project config (.brisk.yaml)
description: Read from the base commit, so a change cannot loosen the rules that judge it. Every key is optional. Unknown keys, unknown rule IDs, out-of-range thresholds and a second YAML document are errors that stop every assessment until the base branch is fixed. A preset sets the policy, and the other policy keys adjust it.

sensitive_paths.description: Project rules: changing a matching path sets at least this tier. They hit as config:<id>.

content_rules.description: Project rules on changed lines: a matching non-comment line in a matching path sets at least this tier. They hit as config:<id>.

paths.description: gitignore-style globs, ** allowed; empty means every code file

pattern.description: Go RE2 regular expression, matched against each changed line

questions.description: The project's own yes/no questions, asked in the same model request. Uncalibrated: they raise the tier only through raise_to and never lower it.

id.description: Must not be one of brisk's question names

raise_to.description: Tier when the answer is at least min; omit to only record the answer

reason.description: Shown in reasons when the question raises the tier; never in agent_review.reason

review_checks.description: A team's own review area for a project rule (sensitive_paths, content_rules) or question, keyed by its id. Used in agent_review.plan with source config in place of brisk's generic project-rule area.

preset.description: autonomous: nobody reviews by hand; High (about 26% of changes in the evaluation) asks for an agent review. reviewed (default): human reviewers; the calibrated thresholds. strict: high-stakes code; wider Medium and High, and an agent review for every Medium or High change. The names match the Amp plugin's amp.brisk.preset.

high_share.description: Share of changes the model alone puts at High, through the calibration's risk quantiles

medium_share.description: Share of changes the model alone puts at Medium or above

thresholds.description: Model risk thresholds (0–1); they win over the shares

overrides.description: Replace the calibration's overrides: an answer at or above min raises the model tier

rule_tiers.description: The tier a rule or finding sets, by hit ID (for example migration, dependencies, lang:sql_changed, or a sensitive_paths id)

actions.description: The action text for each tier

agent_review.description: When to recommend an agent review. Any one condition is enough; a key left out keeps the preset's value.

min_tier.description: Recommend at or above this tier; none turns the tier condition off

min_uncertainty.description: Recommend when Jev rates the change at least this weakly verified; 0 turns it off

questions.description: Recommend when a yes/no answer reaches its minimum, such as weakens_auth: 0.5

rules.description: Recommend when any of these hit IDs fires
